mapper.select: SELECT i.interview_sq, c.company_sq, c.company_nm, u.user_nm, i.interview_status, u.user_sq, i.interview_created_at, i.interview_modified_at, i.interview_request_txt FROM TBL_INTERVIEW_S i LEFT JOIN TBL_COMPANY_S c ON c.company_sq = i.company_sq LEFT JOIN TBL_USER_M u ON u.user_sq = i.user_sq
